criteria.name: Local 72-hour rainfall
criteria.description: Computes 111.7 mm for both the March 12-14 local total and the maximum rolling 72-hour total.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for one correct total, or 3 points for both totals with only minor rounding or window-edge error.

criteria.name: Rolling ratio
criteria.description: Computes the maximum 24-hour to 72-hour precipitation ratio as 0.504.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct formula with a wrong rolling numerator, or 3 points for a correct ratio rounded less precisely.

criteria.name: Wet-run duration
criteria.description: Computes the longest continuous wet run as 62 hours using hourly precipitation greater than 0.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a continuous wet-run calculation with a minor threshold or endpoint mistake.

criteria.name: Catalog lag
criteria.description: Computes the Malawi flood start lag after Freddy TC end as 1.42 days.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the right timestamps but rounding or time-unit conversion incorrectly.

criteria.name: Gust ratio
criteria.description: Computes maximum local gust as 65.9 km/h and the local-gust to GDACS-peak-wind ratio as 0.264.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for one correct gust value or for a correct division with imprecise rounding.

criteria.name: JSON and label
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON and the short computed consequence label linked_multi_day_runoff_pulse.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right label with missing proof details or for a correct proof but incomplete JSON.
